title: The Hole, 309 Days to the Bloodiest Tragedy
overview: When a spate of gruesome killings rocks the countryside in East Jakarta, army officer Soegeng is tasked with clearing up rumours about the military’s involvement. Soegeng’s investigation, however, confronts him with the foundations of corruption – a truth too close for comfort.

title: Warga Rusun 609
overview: The idiosyncratic tenants of a public housing complex must form a unified front to resist an aggressive municipal demolition plan, all while covertly managing a severe supernatural haunting inside Room 609 by an aggrieved spirit demanding an unfulfilled romantic vow.

title: Conjurig
overview: Following a sudden job loss and the dissolution of his romantic relationship in the capital, a dejected young man retreats to his hometown of Bandung, masking his psychological vulnerabilities by donning a traditional ghost costume within a local street-performing subculture.

title: Digger
overview: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

title: Drishyam: The Conclusion
overview: Years after outsmarting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar's past resurfaces when a new evidence threatens to expose his secret. As the investigation reopens, he must outwit the system once again to save his family.

title: Reawakened Man
overview: Despite unwavering support from his best friend Young-ha and the unwavering support of his younger sister Ye-rin, job seeker Seok Hwan just can't seem to land a job, repeatedly failing interviews. One night, after yet another disastrous interview, he returns home only to be attacked by a group of strangers and killed. But 72 hours after his death, Seok Hwan suddenly opens his eyes as if nothing happened. He soon discovers that he possesses a special ability: no matter how many times he dies, he comes back to life. But there's little time to process his extraordinary new power before a mysterious figure known as Black, who has discovered Hwan's existence, begins hunting him down.  Yet with each resurrection, Seok Hwan grows stronger, unleashing powers beyond anything he could have imagined!

title: Other Mommy
overview: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

title: Midnight Sun
overview: Surabaya is a bustling city, and this documentary captures a 24-hour cycle in the lives of three people whose lives have been shattered by circumstances beyond their control, yet who refuse to be victims.

title: Dominion of Darkness: Rephaim
overview: Following a catastrophic, failed ritual in a remote Indonesian province, two Catholic exorcists are deployed to confront a devastatingly powerful ancient entity unleashed by an ancestral pact for illicit wealth.

title: Hasut
overview: In the wake of their parents' tragic decease, a young woman orchestrates a remote wilderness expedition to rehabilitate her estranged sister, only for the group to be terrorized by manipulative supernatural entities exploiting their communication devices.

title: Cidro Asmoro
overview: When a musician's composition achieves unexpected digital virality through a café waitress's unauthorized cover, a commercial strategist orchestrates a collaborative duet between the two artists, igniting an interpersonal conflict driven by their sharply contrasting professional objectives.

title: The Social Reckoning
overview: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

title: Street Fighter
overview: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

title: Whalefall
overview: Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

title: Bapak Paling Jujur
overview: A highly calculated gubernatorial candidate finds his meticulously engineered political campaign and public persona thrown into absolute disarray when a maternal curse renders him entirely incapable of deception, forcing him to navigate the political arena with unfiltered, absolute honesty.

title: Ghosthing
overview: A stoic mortician endowed with the ability to perceive the deceased finds his quiet existence upended when the dramatic spirit of a high-profile influencer refuses to depart, forcing him into an unauthorized investigation to prove her sudden demise was the result of homicide.

title: Jailer 2
overview: When a dangerous syndicate expands its reach to threaten his family's peace, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian goes undercover as a driver. Operating from the shadows, he takes on ruthless new enemies to protect his home.

title: NAZA
overview: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians.

title: Clayface
overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

title: Siti Vampire
overview: Siti is an ordinary girl who accidentally turned into a vampire due to a strange incident. She is trapped at the age of 25 forever, along with all her problems. Siti must find a way to cure herself and return to being a normal human being.

title: Uniform: Cinta di Balik Seragam
overview: Young officer Jason must face a bitter reality. Lara, his girlfriend, has been murdered in a staged accident. Noticing numerous inconsistencies, he asks the Commander to join the investigation. A series of events reveals facts linking a criminal syndicate to the tragedy that befell his girlfriend.

title: Henry's First Dates
overview: Lucy, a woman who's living her first date on repeat with Henry, a good-natured, animal-loving guy with a bizarre condition: every time he wakes up, he can't remember anything from the day before.

title: Udta Teer
overview: An amnesiac Pakistani spy wakes up believing he is a patriotic Indian counter-terrorism officer.

title: TOMORROW X TOGETHER WORLD TOUR 'ACT : TOMORROW'
overview: Like shining stars, TOMORROW X TOGETHER’s fourth world tour 'ACT : TOMORROW' unfolds as a dazzling journey toward the tomorrow they promised together. From its beautiful storytelling to the stunning production and powerful live performances that captivated MOA around the world, experience the immersive energy of TOMORROW X TOGETHER’s spectacular world tour on the big screen!

title: SEVENTEEN WORLD TOUR 'NEW_'
overview: Celebrating their 10th debut anniversary, SEVENTEEN embarks on a world tour fueled by their determination for a fresh start, just like the title 'NEW_'. With their unrivaled stage presence and explosive energy, SEVENTEEN once again proves their unlimited potential. Experience the blazing heat of the concert—bursting with each member’s unique charm—right on the big screen!

title: HYBE CHEERING PARTY
overview: The heat of cheering for HYBE artists unfolds in cinemas! Sing along with your favorite HYBE Artists in 3D! A one-of-a-kind game-like cheering screening is coming, where fans can chant fan cheers and wave their light sticks while watching the music videos of BTS, SEVENTEEN, TOMORROW X TOGETHER, ENHYPEN, LE SSERAFIM, &TEAM, BOYNEXTDOOR, TWS, ILLIT, KATSEYE, aoen, CORTIS, and SANTOS BRAVOS on the big screen. Join this unforgettable celebration filled with diverse music, passionate fan energy, and a dazzling wave of Light Sticks!

title: The Sea Speaks His Name
overview: Set during the volatile final months of Indonesia’s New Order regime, the narrative chronicles a young student activist's perilous commitment to pro-democracy underground movements and his family's subsequent, grueling quest for justice following his forced disappearance.

title: The Intern
overview: A story about what happens when Sun-woo, the CEO of a fashion company who is more passionate than anyone when it comes to work, hires Ki-ho, who has a wealth of life experience, as a silver intern.
